items.title: Tyrese Haliburton just came out of the tunnel with pep in his step. Took a seat on the bench, appears to be in a good mood and just celebrated an Obi Toppin 3. First starter back with the team - the rest still back in the locker room.

quote.author: Tony East
quote.text: Haliburton walks off the court somewhat gingerly — nothing too abnormal — as halftime arrives. He had 17 points and 6 assists in the first half. I'd be surprised if he played in the second half. Pacers up 71-56.
